mapper.select: SELECT REVIEW_ID, MEMBER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, ORDER_ITEM_ID, RATING, REVIEW_CONTENT, REVIEW_STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM REVIEW WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
SELECT REVIEW_ID, MEMBER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, ORDER_ITEM_ID, RATING, REVIEW_CONTENT, REVIEW_STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM REVIEW WHERE REVIEW_ID = #{reviewId} AND MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
SELECT IMAGE_ID, REVIEW_ID, IMAGE_URL, IMAGE_ORIGIN_NAME, IMAGE_NAME, IMAGE_SIZE, IMAGE_TYPE, DISPLAY_ORDER FROM REVIEW_IMAGE WHERE REVIEW_ID = #{reviewId} ORDER BY DISPLAY_ORDER ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE REVIEW SET RATING = #{rating}, REVIEW_CONTENT = #{reviewContent}, UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE REVIEW_ID = #{reviewId} AND MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO REVIEW_IMAGE ( REVIEW_ID, IMAGE_URL, IMAGE_ORIGIN_NAME, IMAGE_NAME, IMAGE_SIZE, IMAGE_TYPE, DISPLAY_ORDER ) VALUES ( #{reviewId}, #{imageUrl}, #{imageOriginName}, #{imageName}, #{imageSize}, #{imageType}, #{displayOrder} )
